mapper.insert: INSERT INTO med_appointment ( patient_id, slot_id, status, confirm_deadline, cancel_deadline ) VALUES ( #{patientId}, #{slotId}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{confirmDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{cancelDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
INSERT INTO med_appointment_status_log ( appointment_id, from_status, to_status, event_type, actor_user_id ) VALUES ( #{appointmentId}, NULL, #{toStatus}, #{eventType}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.select: SELECT appointment.id, appointment.patient_id, appointment.slot_id, appointment.status, appointment.confirm_deadline, appointment.cancel_deadline FROM med_appointment appointment INNER JOIN med_patient patient ON patient.id = appointment.patient_id WHERE appointment.id = #{appointmentId} AND patient.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE med_appointment appointment INNER JOIN med_patient patient ON patient.id = appointment.patient_id SET appointment.status = 'BOOKED' WHERE appointment.id = #{appointmentId} AND patient.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND appointment.status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION' AND appointment.confirm_deadline > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO med_appointment_status_log ( appointment_id, from_status, to_status, event_type, actor_user_id ) VALUES ( #{appointmentId}, 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', 'BOOKED', 'CONFIRMED', #{actorUserId} )
